project_type: Expo 57 React Native mobile app + Next.js 16 web app with shared PostgreSQL backend
build_system: Bun for web (bun run build), Expo CLI for mobile (expo start, expo run:android/ios)
test_framework: bun test (web and mobile unit tests)
build_command: Web: bun run build (prisma generate + next build); Mobile: expo start (dev), eas build (production)
test_command: bun test tests/ lib/services/ (web), cd m && bun test (mobile)
verification_instructions: Web: bunx tsc --noEmit (type check), bun test (unit tests). Mobile: cd m && bun run typecheck && bun test. Runtime validation requires actual Android emulator/device or iOS simulator.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma/client generated via prisma generate (committed .prisma/client/). No snapshots checked in.
environment_constraints: Mobile runtime validation (Android/iOS) may not be available in automation environment. Static validation (tsc, tests) is mandatory. Never report Android tested without actual runtime execution.
contribution_requirements: AI Constitution (docs/07-ai/AI Constitution.md), mobile architecture standards (.agents/rules/mobile-architecture-and-standards.md), database safety (no hard deletes on soft-delete tables, no unscoped bulk operations), styling consistency (design-system components, semantic tokens), web domain logic is authoritative source of truth
key_patterns: Web: Server actions (app/actions/*.ts) → Domain services (lib/services/*.ts) → Prisma (lib/db.ts). Mobile: API client (m/src/api/client.ts) → Repository (m/src/db/repository/*.ts) → SQLite cache + mutation outbox → UI. Soft deletion universal (deletedAt field). Work sessions atomic with ActivityLog. Recurrence computed at runtime (never persisted). Feature flags control rollout.
directory_structure: Web: app/ (Next.js routes/actions), lib/ (services, db, utils), modules/ (domain features), design-system/ (components), prisma/ (schema). Mobile: m/src/app/ (Expo Router screens), m/src/api/ (API client), m/src/db/ (SQLite repositories), m/src/domain/ (business logic), m/src/features/ (feature modules), m/src/components/ (design system), m/src/theme/ (tokens).
